rationale: X stands out with its architectural survey-sheet lighthouse elevation, annotated callouts, and a night-timeline with durations, giving a specific and original product visual with refined serif typography. Z is a cohesive, polished dark page with a nice tilted room card and illustrated lighthouse but follows a more familiar card-grid structure. Y is the most template-like: a cream and green alternating-band layout, a generic tile-grid game card (which also overlaps awkwardly on mobile), and a standard SaaS section rhythm.
